messages:
Emma: Heads-up — enterprise canary for Acme (Dedicated) needs traffic split + isolation guards. Thinking: 5% traffic to v2, hard CPU/GPU quota per-tenant, and auto-fallback to v1 on latency errors. Anyone seen pitfalls with per-tenant routing + shared pool?

Raj: +1. Main risk is noisy neighbor effects when we allow burst > baseline. Need rate limiting at route and node level.

Liz: For the API shape, I'd prefer: `POST /api/v1/rollouts` body:
```
{
  "tenant_id": "acme",
  "policy": "canary",
  "splits": [{"variant": "v2", "pct": 5}],
  "guards": {"max_qps": 50, "cpu_pct_limit": 0.2}
}
```
— simple and explicit.

Mike: 👀 prefer percent expressed as per-ten-thousand to avoid float rounding. Also add `isolation_level: \"soft|hard\"`.

Sofia: Console UX: we should show live SLO metrics next to the split (p50/p95 latency, error rate, token cost). Add a toggle 'auto-fallback on error' with threshold.

Emma: Agree. What telemetry do we need? per-tenant token latency histograms? per-variant success ratio? rollout events in event-log?

Raj: Need: `requests`, `errors`, `latency_p50/p95`, `model_fallbacks`, `quota_breaches`. Also track `capacity_usage` per GPU pool.

Liz: Implementation note — routing layer can consult tenant policy in cache; for Dedicated customers we must pin to allocated pools. So policy must include `pools_allowed`.

Mike: Ops concern: if v2 triggers memory spike, we must be able to quarantine tenant slice fast. Add `max_mem_pct_per_node` guard with auto-drain.

Emma: Good. Can we express these guards as a single DSL? e.g., `guards: [{type: \"latency\", threshold: 200, action: \"rollback\"}, ...]`

Sofia: DSL is great for console + API parity. But keep simple defaults for non-experts. Recommended guard template: `safe-canary-enterprise-v1`.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: rollout/acme-v2 5% -> <https://deploys.internal/acme/v2|link>

ops-bot: Alert: acme/v2 p95 latency > 1.2s for last 5m. auto-fallback triggered -> v1 (1min ago)

Emma: Thx both — confirm action items: Liz to propose API schema, Raj to list telemetry metrics and retention, Mike to add ops guard hooks, Sofia to mock console UI. I'll schedule 30m sync tomorrow. :calendar:

Liz: Will post JSON schema in #eng-platform tomorrow.

Raj: Will add Prometheus + tracing metrics, retention 90d for rollout events.

Mike: I'll add circuit-breaker + drain implementation notes.

Sofia: I'll drop a figma link in the thread.

Emma: cool. If anyone else has objections speak now.

Raj: small ask — include a maximum allowed canary pct for Dedicated customers (default 10%).

Emma: noted, will include default caps.
